visual_observations: Recognizable adult A1 face, silver-gray grouped long hair, ring clip, gray-blue eyes, original studs and gentle expression remain close to source.
Entire head, both hands and both ankle boots remain visible with clear margins; original relaxed stance is preserved.

Charcoal velvet-like bodice, restrained square neckline, short puff sleeves, defined waist, smoky-lilac layered A-line skirt, silver waist clasp and lace-up boots create a distinct soft gothic daywear silhouette.
No new head ornaments, theatrical makeup, crosses, chains or corset lacing; hands, garment structure and pale source-like background are coherent.
deviations: Lace at the hem is a wider detailed band rather than very limited fine trim.
Ankle boots retain a modest block heel rather than a particularly low one.
Velvet-like material has somewhat stronger textured highlights than the requested restrained color blocks.
